text: たたかう　ポケモンの　すばやさを　いちじてきに　あげるの

structure.jp: たたかう　ポケモンの　すばやさを
structure.en: the Speed of the Pokémon in battle

structure.jp: いちじてきに　あげるの

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たたかう　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. たたかう ポケモン = 'the Pokémon that is fighting'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is a soft, often feminine form of のだ, used when explaining something. あげるの = 'it raises it, you see'.
